proves.claim: pullboard main-red-files set writes the sorted, deduplicated repo paths to board_meta gate_main_red_files for the coordinator, the bare command prints them one per line, and --clear writes an empty array.

cli.main-red-files.coordinator-sets-list.why: Without it the coordinator edits the board database by hand to change the list the gate settle reads.

proves.claim: pullboard main-red-files is refused COORDINATOR_ONLY for a seat and USAGE naming an absolute path, a . or .. segment, or a newline or NUL, leaving gate_main_red_files unchanged.

cli.main-red-files.refuses-unchanged.why: Without it a seat could excuse its own red, or a path the gate never names could enter the list.

proves.claim: pullboard main-red-files is discovered from its own command file and listed in the Coordinator help group shown by pullboard help --all.

cli.main-red-files.discovered-and-listed.why: Without it the command could exist without a way to find it, or need a shared command file edit.
